mapper.sql: SELECT ID, INSTANCE_ID, MODEL_ID, PARENT_ID, TABLE_ROLE, PARENT_TABLE_ID, DATASOURCE_ID, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COMMENT, INDEX_DEFINITION, ENABLED_FLAG, VERIFIED_TIME, VALID_FLAG, DEL_FLAG, CREATOR_ID, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATER_ID, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, REMARK FROM MODEL_MATERIALIZED_TABLE

FROM MODEL_MATERIALIZED_TABLE t INNER JOIN MODEL_INSTANCE i ON i.ID = t.INSTANCE_ID AND i.STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED' INNER JOIN MODEL_BASE b ON b.ID = i.MODEL_ID AND b.PUBLISHED_INSTANCE_ID = i.ID WHERE b.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MODEL_VERSION v WHERE v.ID = b.VERSION_ID AND v.MODEL_ID = b.ID AND v.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND v.STATUS IN (1, 2)) AND t.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND t.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND t.ENABLED_FLAG = '1' AND t.TABLE_ROLE = 'AUTHORITY' AND ((t.PARENT_ID = 0 AND t.MODEL_ID = b.ID) OR (t.PARENT_ID = b.ID AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MODEL_BASE child INNER JOIN MODEL_VERSION cv ON cv.ID = child.VERSION_ID AND cv.MODEL_ID = child.ID WHERE child.ID = t.MODEL_ID AND child.PARENT_ID = b.ID AND child.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND cv.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND cv.STATUS IN (0, 1, 2) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MODEL_MATERIALIZED_TABLE p WHERE p.ID = t.PARENT_TABLE_ID AND p.INSTANCE_ID = t.INSTANCE_ID AND p.MODEL_ID = b.ID AND p.PARENT_ID = 0 AND p.TABLE_ROLE = t.TABLE_ROLE AND p.ENABLED_FLAG = '1' AND p.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND p.DEL_FLAG = '0' )))
mapper.select:
SELECT t.MODEL_ID
AND t.PARENT_ID = 0 GROUP BY t.MODEL_ID HAVING COUNT(1) > 1
